# Humanly — HR Advisory for UAE & GCC Professionals

## What Humanly Does
Humanly provides confidential, neutral HR advice for professionals in the UAE and GCC.
We bridge the gap between internal HR (who protects the company) and employment lawyers
(who pursue litigation). We protect the individual.

## Who We Serve
- Professionals facing toxic managers or workplace issues in the UAE
- Employees dealing with Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) in Dubai
- Workers navigating redundancy, termination, or gratuity rights in the UAE
- Expats confused about UAE labour law and their rights
- Anyone who needs confidential HR guidance without their employer knowing

## Services
- **The Triage**: 60-minute confidential advisory session — verbal guidance and clarity
- **The Strategy**: Written follow-up report with situation summary, risk assessment,
  recommended actions, and suggested scripts
- **The Retainer**: Ongoing monthly support for complex situations

## Founder

Founder & Principal HR Advisor at Humanly.
